shots.prompt: Cozy neighbourhood barbershop in Brazil (Barbearia do Samuel), warm late-afternoon natural light, vintage mirrors, plants, a green waiting bench. Samuel, the barber, is a white Brazilian man in his mid-30s with fair skin, short dark brown hair and a well-groomed beard, wearing a plain dark green shirt; he runs the clippers over a client's hair while they chat. The client, under a plain dark green barber cape with no print, laughs genuinely. On the bench a woman smiles proudly at her husband in the chair and another client waits casually.
